script:
INT. QUIET OFFICE - DAY

TRAVELER sits alone at a desk. Soft daylight falls through a window. She looks up, thoughtful.

TRAVELER
We still have some time.

INT. TRAIN COMPARTMENT - NIGHT

TRAVELER sits alone beside a dark window in a quiet, stationary train. She turns from the window and pauses.

TRAVELER
The next train leaves at noon.
